rule: Money is attributed only to the entity that gave it. Controller personal/family giving is separate from a parent-company PAC. Index-fund PACs are omitted. Employee bundling at Amazon or Disney is not treated as Jeff Bezos or ABC News.

records.summary: Anschutz and spouse: more than $5 million in state and federal contributions since 1989. After 2016, almost entirely Republican party committees, candidates, and conservative super PACs (NRSC, NRCC, RNC, Senate Leadership Fund).

Bezos's own FEC candidate giving after buying the Post has been small and split (WA Democrats and UT Republicans). Amazon PAC and Amazon-employee totals are a different entity and are not attached to The Washington Post.

News Corporation PAC 2024 disbursements totaled $30,500, described by the company as nearly even between the parties. Separate $50,000 corporate 527 split RAGA/DAGA. This is the parent PAC, not Fox News or the New York Post.

OpenSecrets 2024 cycle total for Comcast Corp and affiliates: about $7.4 million, mix of PAC and employee giving. Comcast/NBCU federal PAC raised $2.7M and spent $2.4M in the 2025–26 window. Not NBC News's money.
OpenSecrets 2024 Walt Disney Co total ~$3.55M. Vast majority is employees, not the corporate PAC (~$244k PAC). Lean Democratic. Not ABC News's money.

Michael Bloomberg is one of the largest self-funders and Democratic outside spenders in modern cycles, including his own presidential campaign. Treat as controller giving, not as 'Bloomberg News donated.' Line-item FEC ingest is the next pass.
